director.name: 小埃尔维西奥·马林斯 Helvécio Marins Jr.

introduction: Documentary that tells the centenary history of the soccer team, Clube Atlético Mineiro, from its foundation, in 1908, to the title of the 2014 Brazil Cup, through the epic conquest of the "Libertadores da América" in 2013. A team born from the utopia of uniting black and white , the poor and the rich, and who resist misfortune and injustice on and off the field. A documentary that transcends football, and reveals the DNA of one of the most loyal and unique fans in world football.
